verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's own HyperAgent is documented as an open-source framework that extends Playwright with AI (page.ai, page.extract). That implies it can drive a browser on the developer's machine, but the platform docs otherwise describe agents and sessions as managed cloud browsers. No evidence explicitly states a local-browser mode or that no cloud account or API key is needed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running HyperAgent against a local browser, explicit confirmation that no Hyperbrowser account or API key is required, and hands-on corroboration of local use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent against a local browser on my own machine for development, without any cloud account

citations.quote: HyperAgent is our open-source tool that supercharges Playwright with AI.
HyperAgent is an open-source browser automation framework that extends Playwright with AI capabilities.
